entries.en: Dummy

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I couldn't do much when we were[n]gatherin' information, but when it[n]comes to fightin' you can count on me!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A restaurant, huh... I was just gettin'[n]hungry.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Alright, one down! Let's keep it up, Joker!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can't use our Personas when we're[n]mice, huh...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's try to avoid battles if we get caught[n]in traps like this later on, yeah?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We got 'em good that time![n]So, how didjya like my plan?
Flawless.
Terrible.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right!? I can use my head too y'know!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You think so...? I actually already[n]apologized to Panther and the others...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That Shadow looked pretty intimidating...[n]No tellin' what it'll do to us if it spots us.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell was that yakuza-like stuff!?[n]That prolly WAS a yakuza, man!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're not doin' too bad, huh? Just[n]a little more and we'll be done!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm so done bein' a mouse... How[n]much more of this we got?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We know where our target is now,[n]so let's get 'im!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sweet, now all that's left is gettin'[n]that yakuza. I'd rather not deal with[n]him, but we've gotta do this!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why the hell did it have to end up like[n]this... Akechi was a victim too, dammit...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're almost there! This'll be the end for[n]sure. Let's do it, Joker!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Shido's social importance, authority,[n]assets, and desires are all off the charts.[n]Don't let your guard down, okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's head to the restaurant. We'll[n]probably find this Ooe there.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, that's one down. We know[n]where our next target is, so let's hurry[n]and get over there.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Being turned into a mouse was[n]humiliating... It felt so strange, too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we'd known it was a guy who was only[n]interested in lineage... We probably didn't[n]even need Skull's plan.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He has the gall to give speeches about this[n]country's future when the view from his[n]boat is this bad!? I can't believe this guy...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So that cleaner will come out if we make a[n]scene, huh... It would be a hassle to go for[n]him now, so let's get the other two first.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The next letter of introduction's from[n]the president of an IT company, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We've got no info on him, so he may be[n]a bit difficult to find.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I can't believe I'm saying it, but I think[n]I'm getting used to this mouse form...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That cleaner said we're off the hook,[n]but there's no way we can trust him.[n]Everyone, stay on your guard!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oracle took charge and went off on her[n]own! We'd better keep up!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We've gotta fulfill our part of the deal.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I wasn't fond of him, but it's because of him[n]that we'll be able to fight against Shido!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I can't forgive what Akechi did, but we[n]still have to fulfill our part of the deal!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All the people who have letters of[n]introduction have such grand titles...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And now we're going against the person[n]who's controlling them. We can't let our[n]guard down.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I bet Shido always goes to these kinds[n]of fancy restaurants...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So he destroyed Joker's life, but gets[n]to cruise through his own? I'll never[n]forgive him.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There were all those rumors about[n]him being a "womanizer"... I have a[n]bad feeling about this.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I was shocked when my perspective was[n]suddenly from the floor... Plus, it's hard to[n]fight and run around like this.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: His lineage might be grand, but the guy[n]himself was just a pervert.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: A politician and a former noble... I'm sure[n]the next one will be just as bad.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I don't know what's wrong with that[n]scary looking guy... He kept intimidating[n]us, too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We're taking care of that cleaner later, so[n]the IT president's up next, right? I wonder[n]if it's true that he never leaves his room.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We haven't been able to find any clues on[n]where the IT President is, huh... Let's just[n]have patience and keep searching.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We finally found out where the IT[n]president is! Let's get going!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That makes four. Now the only one left is[n]the cleaner... I'm a bit scared, but we have[n]to go for it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If only we'd met Akechi-kun a little sooner.[n]I'm sure we would've been able to become[n]good friends...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We're almost there, Joker. Are you[n]nervous?
Not at all.
Yeah.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: As confident as always. We'll be counting[n]on you to the very end!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Really? I'm surprised. But I guess things[n]are a bit different this time.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't worry. We're all here for you, Joker!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To think that we require letters of[n]recommendation from cognitive[n]beings in order to see the Palace Ruler...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ideally, they would simply give us their[n]letters if we asked for them... But I doubt[n]it will be that easy.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The furniture on this boat is odd... It seems[n]representative of his self-centered nature.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I did not expect that the cognitive beings[n]would become Shadows. Knowing we have[n]4 more, we cannot let our guard down.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: "This is prepawsterous!" Strange... I put[n]a great amount of thought into that pun.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Panther's acting skills have improved quite[n]a bit. I wonder if she has been practicing...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Again!? What is going on!? Everyone should[n]have been rolling on the floor laughing...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If we cause any more disturbances, he may[n]come at us with his full strength. We must[n]stay on our toes.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Madarame had connections with Shido...[n]What a strange twist of fate.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I find it surprising that the targets we are[n]pursuing for these letters do not have[n]Palaces of their own.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Whether we cause disturbances or sit still,[n]the cleaner will pursue us. We cannot[n]simply ignore him.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We have Oracle to thank for this one.[n]I suppose that as the first ever Medjed,[n]this would have been a given.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: His father was Shido... So Akechi was[n]fighting against him as well.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This Palace has distorted the world[n]powerfully. Be sure you are fully[n]prepared.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I feel like the Treasure's close by... But I'm[n]certain it's going to take a lot longer than[n]we think.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I feel bad using something that someone[n]dropped, but I suppose we'll just have to[n]borrow it for now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Politicians using psychotic breakdowns in[n]order to remove enemies... I wonder what[n]degree of involvement Shido had.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My power is limited when I'm a mouse...[n]Let's proceed with caution from now on.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I had a bad feeling about this from the[n]beginning...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm glad things turned out okay, but we[n]must think over Skull's plans from now on!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That heavily armed Shadow came out of[n]nowhere... We must proceed with caution[n]to avoid further dangers.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That man from earlier... he reminded me[n]of Kaneshiro. Although he was much more[n]intimidating than that money monger.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I had no idea that Kaneshiro's money was[n]going to Shido... I didn't expect this kind[n]of connection.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's take a moment before we go for our[n]next letter. We need to think about what[n]to do with the cleaner.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's forget the cleaner for now. We must[n]first find a way to the IT president's room.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oracle sure has grown.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was a little concerned when I heard she[n]was going alone, but I guess I didn't need[n]to worry at all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I didn't think Akechi-kun would be one to[n]help us... Let's make sure we fulfill our part[n]of the deal!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What should we do with the calling[n]card this time...? Oracle was saying[n]she had an idea.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Do you remember the information of[n]the 5 VIPs? Be sure to double check so[n]we don't make a mistake.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I wonder what kind of person this Ooe is...[n]Hopefully he's at the restaurant.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Even the school principal was affected by[n]this...? How many people suffered because[n]of Shido...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Putting aside how Shido sees us... I[n]personally thought our mouse forms[n]were pretty cute!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I suppose it's okay since we were[n]successful, but was Skull's plan truly[n]necessary?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Fox's joke, about "paw-something"...[n]Um, we're not all born comedians.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I wonder why people would take Shido's[n]side, even knowing they may be betrayed...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I will change Shido's heart for my father[n]as well.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Our next target may be difficult to find if[n]we don't know where he is...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: He doesn't even leave his room to eat...[n]I wonder if he's truly just that busy.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I wonder how we're to take the letter from[n]the cleaner?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Akechi-kun entrusted us with changing[n]Shido's heart... We must be sure to succeed.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: An impactful calling card that reaches[n]Shido...? I wonder how we can do that...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Talking to all those people was super[n]exhausting... I think I've used up my[n]lifetime's worth of communication abilities.
Good job.
I'll count on you next time too.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mweheh... Yes, good, praise me more!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: N-Next time!? I'll... think about it.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'd choose Sojiro's curry over this fancy,[n]expensive restaurant food any day.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Whoa... Queen ordered so easily, I'm[n]impressed...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Rodents huh... Even rodents can be[n]powerful if they band together, you[n]know.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm gonna wipe that former noble issue[n]from my memory... On to the next one!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Looks like the boss of an FPS or something...[n]Let's go slow and steady, all right?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It may have just been a cognitive being,[n]but that guy was still super creepy. I'd[n]rather not get involved with him...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Next up is the IT president guy, right? I[n]wonder where he's got himself shut in.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: An IT president that has money AND is a[n]shut-in... What a cheater!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A person's room is like their safe zone...[n]I totally get that president's feelings!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: D-Did you see that!? I can do stuff too!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I won't forgive him for what he did to my[n]mom... but I still appreciate Akechi for[n]helping us.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Leave the calling card to me! I'll put out a[n]super good one!
